detail: src/rade/ingestion/telegram/ has client.py, parser.py and backfill.py; scripts/shadow_collect.py polls with iter_messages(min_id=...) rather than subscribing to events. There is no push listener, so live latency has never been measured.
gaps: no push listener: latency cannot be measured from stored data
no received_at column: ingested_at is set on first insert and is poll-time, not receipt-time
no revision column: backfill upserts in place, so an edit destroys the previous body
edit detection is bounded to the last 50 ids (shadow_collect.py), so older edits are invisible - the frozen spec says so explicitly
